event_records.description: The CEO of Kestrel Analytics is aware of the proposed five-year lease on Riverside Wharf and the landlord's offer of six months rent-free. The option expires next Friday.

ceo_of_kestrel_analytics.name: CEO of Kestrel Analytics
ceo_of_kestrel_analytics.persona_brief:
You are CEO of Kestrel Analytics.
The CEO is considering the five-year lease on Riverside Wharf. They know headcount plans were cut 20% last quarter and half the team is remote. The CFO privately prefers a shorter term. The CEO must decide before the landlord's option expires next Friday.

landlord_of_riverside_wharf.name: Landlord of Riverside Wharf
landlord_of_riverside_wharf.persona_brief:
You are Landlord of Riverside Wharf.
The landlord has offered six months rent-free as an incentive. They have set an option expiration date of next Friday (2026-08-21) for the CEO to sign or walk away.

resolution.question: Will Kestrel Analytics' CEO sign, or walk away from, the proposed five-year lease on the Riverside Wharf office before the landlord's option expires next Friday?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the CEO signed the lease before the cutoff (2026-08-21T17:00:00+01:00). Resolve NO if the CEO explicitly walks away or the deadline passes without signing.
